description: This file defines a front-end route component for creating new events within a Remix-based web application. It includes server-side loader and action functions for data fetching and form submission, as well as a React component rendering a form for event creation.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Loads the route, ensuring the user is authenticated before allowing access to the create event form.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new event, sending data to the backend API and redirecting upon success.

methods.name: NewEvent
methods.description: React component rendering the event creation form with UI feedback for errors and submission state.
